title: fill_slide
description: Write what an existing slide says (its title, subtitle and points), in its layout's places: what it said there is replaced. For a slide made empty, or rewritten whole.

slide_id.description: The slide's number or ID. Left out: the slide the request is about; in an empty deck, a new first slide.

content.description: What the slide says; the application places each part in the layout. Only text from the request or a source, never filler.

subtitle.description: A line that adds to the title; never the title again.

points.description: Its points, in order: short lines in your words, or {heading, text} (a column, a phase).

sources.description: Titles of the KB documents it comes from (cited in the notes).

layout.description: Put the slide on this layout first (Layouts of this deck). Left out: its layout, or, when that has no place for the points, the one that fits them.
